setting: A student is speaking with a receptionist at the campus health center about scheduling an appointment.
narrator_intro: Listen to a conversation between a student and a receptionist at the student health center.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Hi, I need to see a doctor about a sports injury, I hurt my ankle playing basketball yesterday. Do I need an appointment or can I walk in?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: For injuries like that, we actually recommend the walk-in clinic downstairs rather than scheduling with your regular doctor, it'll be faster.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Oh, I didn't know there was a separate clinic for that. How long is the wait usually?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: It varies, but right now the board shows about a forty-minute wait. If you'd rather book a regular appointment instead, the earliest opening is tomorrow afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Forty minutes is fine, I'd rather get it looked at today. Do I need to bring anything?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Just your student ID and insurance card if you have one on file. If it turns out you need an X-ray, they'll send you to the imaging center across the street.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Got it. Is the visit itself covered by my student health fee, or will I be charged separately?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: The visit itself is covered, but if you need an X-ray or a boot for your ankle, those come with a small additional charge.

narrator_outro: Now get ready to answer the questions.
